closed_reason: Landed: deterministic SVG attribute serialization order (commit a15d5134).
description: Repeated renders of identical input emit attributes in varying order (e.g. marker path 'fill=none stroke-width=2' vs 'stroke-width=2 fill=none'), causing docs/images churn on every eval run. Likely HashMap iteration in the SVG element builder. Make attribute order deterministic (insertion order). TDD: render same diagram twice, assert byte-identical output.
title: svg: nondeterministic attribute order in emitted SVG elements
